text: I received a credit card charge yesterday for {$1.00} for something I did not sign up for. Following the charge on XXXX, I was led to " Your Score and More ''. After 15 minutes, the service line ( that I had to dig for a long time to find, as the one on the website is clearly fake ) finally answered and it sounded like someone was loudly watching football. Preprepared script attempting to upsell and wouldn't take no for an answer until I said I was going to report them.

meta.issue: Credit monitoring or identity theft protection services
